rationale: manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=1.5, proj_w=5, proj_kernel=5, bf_d_w_ratio=0.16666666666666666, manduca_N0=100000.0, manduca_bowtie=False, img_n_bf=3, img_kernel=5, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.02, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-2 manduca_bilateral on re-split Breast-CT (train3600/val200/test200 seed20260703, per-iter train_n=400, val=200). SIX-BOX vs iter-1: (1) PRIOR: iter-1 hr=0.2159 val_ssim=0.9742 psnr=38.44 rmse=4.09e-3 in 106.8s at paper-faithful defaults (proj_n_bf=1 proj_sr=1.5 bf_d_w_ratio=1/6 img_n_bf=1 ep=10); cleared FBP baseline strongly; only ~107s of the 1200s budget used. (2) FAILURE MODE: under-denoising -- the 6-param bilateral (1 proj + 1 img filter) leaves substantial 128-view streak/residual in the reconstructed image where calibrated-SSIM-headroom is measured (cf. the DD-UNet's hr=0.81 on the same split; the tiny bilateral is far under-capacity). On Mayo the img_n_bf DEPTH was the primary capacity lever for bilateral-supervised. (3) ONE KNOB: img_n_bf 1->3 (image-domain bilateral cascade depth: +2 trainable image-domain BFs, ~3 params each, placed exactly where the metric lives). All else held (epochs=10, proj_sr=1.5, bf_d_w_ratio=1/6, lr=5e-3). Params 6->12. (4) HYPOTHESIS: raising img_n_bf 1->3 lifts hr above 0.2159 because a deeper image-domain bilateral cascade (Wagner 2022 sec 3.2: cascading BFs enlarge the effective receptive field at ~3 params each) suppresses more surviving 128-view residual noise in the FBP output. FALSIFIER: if hr stays <=~0.22, image-domain depth is not the lever -> iter-3 attacks the proj-domain (proj_sr / bf_d_w_ratio) or epochs. (5) BUDGET: +2 cheap bilateral passes/step; iter-1 ran 107s so this stays far under the 20-min budget (30-min sbatch wall). (6) Loop continues; iter-3 dispatched on landing. --qos=turbo active.
